title: Machine-learning screening guides a measured reversal of the anomalous Nernst signal
summary: A materials-screening study led the authors to test Co₂TiGe single crystals. The preprint reports a reversal of the anomalous Nernst signal near 225 K.

evidence.tested: The authors measured Nernst behavior in single crystals.
evidence.unknown: The abstract establishes the reported selection and measurement. Screening methods and independent replication remain to be checked.
evidence.ai_role: The authors report using learned screening for multiple target properties to select a material for measurement.
